title: HELIX Govern: Access Control Matrix
description: Comprehensive matrix mapping database roles to specific HELIX resources, layers, and operations. The single source of truth for who can access what. Covers all 64 HELIX Core resources across 9 domains, including the Financial Aid and Outcomes resources added in v0.4.0.

role_descriptions.helix_analyst_standard: Gold read-only, public+internal, aggregates only for student data
role_descriptions.helix_analyst_confidential: Gold read with legitimate educational interest (individual student records)
role_descriptions.helix_analyst_restricted: Gold read including restricted data (GLBA financial, HR compensation)
role_descriptions.helix_steward: Silver+Gold read for domain quality oversight
role_descriptions.helix_research: Gold de-identified research extracts under studies agreement
role_descriptions.helix_admin: Grant management and governance administration (no data read)

operations.write: Full read/write access (create, update, alter schema)
operations.read: SELECT access to all columns (subject to masking policies)
operations.aggregate_only: SELECT access but only through aggregate/suppressed views — no individual records
operations.masked_read: SELECT access with PII/restricted columns masked or tokenized
operations.no_access: No access to this resource at this layer

columns: identifiers[].value (where identifiers[].type in national_id, ssn_last4, passport, drivers_license)
column_exceptions.override: Only helix_analyst_restricted sees cleartext. Silver engineers see SHA-256 tokens for identity resolution. All others see 'RESTRICTED'. HELIX Person carries SSN and national IDs inside identifiers[]; bank and routing numbers are not Person attributes. If your institution extends Person with them, add them here.
helix_analyst_confidential and helix_steward see cleartext. helix_analyst_standard sees partial mask (first initial, domain-only email). helix_research sees opaque token.
Only helix_analyst_restricted sees cleartext. All others see 'RESTRICTED' literal. Export-controlled data.

Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext. All others see SHA-256 token or 'RESTRICTED'. For 2024-25 onward the Student Aid Index lives on AidApplication.sai. GLBA 16 CFR 314.4(c)(3) encryption required at rest and in transit.
ISIR and FAFSA-derived values. Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext; everyone else sees SHA-256 token or 'RESTRICTED'. Never surfaced in agent responses (agent-guardrails PQP-05).

Reveals personal circumstances (homelessness, foster care, citizenship). Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext. Never used as a dimension in aggregates without small-cell suppression (ferpa-suppression-policy SUPP-001, SUPP-005).
Need analysis and professional judgment detail. Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext. COA components are institutional budgets and are not masked.
Tax and income verification detail. Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext.

Individual disbursement and refund amounts. Cleartext for helix_analyst_restricted_finaid and bursar staff holding helix_analyst_restricted. Totals by fund and term are available to helix_analyst_standard through suppressed gold aggregates.
Individual loan amounts and COD identifiers. Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext. Aggregate loan volume by type is available in suppressed gold aggregates.
Individual R2T4 calculations. Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext.
Appeal narratives often describe illness, family, or financial hardship. Only helix_analyst_restricted_finaid sees cleartext; the rest of the SAP record follows the confidential template.
Student pay follows HR pay rules. Cleartext for helix_analyst_restricted (finaid or hr subtype). Supervisors and confidential analysts see job details but 'RESTRICTED' for pay.

matrix.note: Nine of ten resources are FERPA education records. FederalAidReport is institution-level aggregate reporting with no student rows. Resources classified restricted are GLBA-covered (16 CFR 314) and follow the restricted grant template.

column_exceptions.override: Individual salary is visible to helix_analyst_confidential with a career-services purpose and to helix_analyst_restricted. helix_research sees salary bands. Published only as suppressed aggregates (median by program with N of at least 5).
With graduation year and program these re-identify a graduate. helix_research and helix_analyst_standard see masked values.
Alumni contact and career detail. Cleartext for helix_analyst_confidential and helix_steward (advancement or enrollment steward); masked for helix_analyst_standard and helix_research.
License numbers identify a person; individual scores are education records. Programs report pass rates as suppressed aggregates.
Third-party supervisor contact details and individual evaluations. Masked for helix_analyst_standard and helix_research.
Award amounts and GPA are not directory information even though the honor itself usually is (34 CFR 99.3). Masked for helix_analyst_standard and helix_research.

matrix.note: Eight of nine resources are FERPA education records. AlumniProfile is not an education record once the data is collected independently after graduation, but it stays confidential. See ACM-SPECIAL-009.

column_exceptions.override: Wealth screening and prospect ratings. Only helix_analyst_confidential with advancement steward authorization. helix_analyst_standard sees aggregate giving by segment only. Constituent names and contact details come from Person and follow the Person PII rule.
Anonymous gifts: donor identity is masked for every role except helix_analyst_confidential holding advancement steward authorization. Gift amounts roll up to segments for helix_analyst_standard.
Only helix_analyst_restricted_hr (benefits subtype) sees cleartext.
Only helix_analyst_restricted_hr sees cleartext. All others see 'RESTRICTED'. Aggregate salary data by department/rank may be exposed to helix_analyst_standard in gold aggregates.
Only helix_analyst_restricted_hr sees cleartext. All others see SHA-256 token. Bank and routing numbers are not HELIX Employee attributes; they stay in the payroll system of record.
Only helix_analyst_restricted_hr sees cleartext. Bank and routing numbers are not HELIX PayrollResult attributes and never leave the payroll system.
Only helix_analyst_restricted_hr sees cleartext. Aggregate ratings by department available to helix_analyst_standard.

special_rules.name: FERPA directory-restricted students
special_rules.description: Any gold view or report consumed by helix_analyst_standard, helix_research, or external systems must exclude students with an active directory information restriction (ferpa_restriction.restrict_directory = true).
special_rules.enforcement: Row-level security policy RLS-001 from lakehouse-rbac-model.json
special_rules.applies_to_resources: All student-facing resources: Person, Student, Enrollment, StudentProgram, AdmissionApplication, TransferCredit, AcademicTermRecord, DegreeAudit, StudentGroup, FinAidAward, Degree, Hold

special_rules.name: GLBA restricted financial data
special_rules.description: Only helix_analyst_restricted with the finaid subtype and named-individual authorization can read GLBA-covered columns on the Financial Aid resources and financial identifiers on Person.
special_rules.enforcement: Column masking policy helix_mask_restricted + named grant
applies_to_resources: Person (identifiers[] where type is national_id or ssn_last4)

special_rules.name: HR restricted data — compensation, benefits, payroll, performance
special_rules.description: Compensation, BenefitEnrollment, PayrollResult, and PerformanceReview require helix_analyst_restricted with the HR subtype. These resources are restricted even to standard confidential analysts.
special_rules.enforcement: Column masking policy helix_mask_restricted + HR-specific named grant
special_rules.note: Aggregate salary/rating data by department, rank, or classification may be exposed via gold aggregate views to helix_analyst_standard for IPEDS, equity analysis, and institutional reporting.

special_rules.name: Steward domain scoping
special_rules.description: Data Stewards see only resources in their assigned domain. A steward for Enrollment cannot read HR tables, and vice versa.
special_rules.enforcement: Domain-specific steward roles: helix_steward_enrollment, helix_steward_hr, helix_steward_finance, helix_steward_advancement, helix_steward_academic. Each variant gets SELECT grants only on their domain's tables.
special_rules.note: AlumniProfile sits in the Outcomes domain (helix_steward_enrollment) and is also readable by helix_steward_advancement through constituent_ref, because it links to the Advancement Constituent record for the same person.

special_rules.name: Research de-identification requirement
special_rules.description: The helix_research role sees only de-identified data. Direct identifiers (name, SSN, email, phone, address) are replaced with opaque tokens. Quasi-identifiers (race, gender, DOB, major, ZIP) are available but subject to small-cell suppression.
special_rules.enforcement: Research-specific gold views with helix_mask_research_deidentify masking policy
special_rules.applies_to_resources: Student-facing resources only. HR, Finance, and Advancement data is not available to the research role.

special_rules.name: Admin separation of duties
special_rules.description: The helix_admin role has no data read access. CDOs or administrators who need to read data for governance oversight must hold a separate analyst role with documented justification.
special_rules.enforcement: helix_admin role has zero SELECT grants on bronze/silver/gold. Admin grants (MANAGE GRANTS, CREATE ROLE, policy management) are separate from data access.
special_rules.rationale: Prevents a single credential compromise from yielding both administrative control and unrestricted data access.

special_rules.name: Small-cell suppression on all aggregates
special_rules.description: Any gold view, report, or agent response that produces aggregate counts, rates, or averages from FERPA education records must apply FERPA small-cell suppression. Cells with fewer than the configured threshold (default: 5) are suppressed.
special_rules.enforcement: Gold views wrap aggregates with helix_suppress() function. Agents apply suppression post-query (see agent-guardrails.json).

special_rules.name: Time-bounded research access
special_rules.description: Research role access expires on the studies agreement end date. Automated revocation with destruction verification.
special_rules.enforcement: RLS policy RLS-005 from lakehouse-rbac-model.json. Automated grant expiration in the grant lifecycle.

special_rules.name: Post-graduation outcomes and alumni data
special_rules.description: AlumniProfile is not a FERPA education record once alumni data is collected independently after graduation, but it stays confidential. Advancement staff reach it through constituent_ref for a documented advancement purpose. Do not bulk-join AlumniProfile or EmploymentOutcome to student education records for solicitation lists without Data Steward review. Individual salary in EmploymentOutcome is published only as suppressed aggregates.
special_rules.enforcement: helix_mask_outcomes_salary and helix_mask_confidential_pii masking policies; RLS steward scoping; SUPP-001 small-cell suppression on published outcomes.

special_rules.name: Aggregate federal aid reporting
special_rules.description: FederalAidReport holds institution-level totals (COD, NSLDS, FISAP, Pell and Direct Loan reconciliation) and no student rows. It is confidential until submitted to the Department of Education, which is why helix_research may read it. Reconciliation variances should be reviewed by the Financial Aid steward before wider sharing.
special_rules.enforcement: Standard confidential grant template; no column masking required.

special_rules.name: Student employment pay
special_rules.description: Wage fields on StudentEmployment follow the same restricted pay rules as HR Compensation and PayrollResult, even though the record is a FERPA education record. Supervisors and advisors see the job, not the pay.

operation_legend.note: The matrix shows the DEFAULT access level for each role×resource×layer combination. Column-level exceptions (in column_exceptions) override the default for specific sensitive columns. For example, a role with 'read' access to Person still sees restricted columns (SSN, bank_account) as masked tokens unless they hold helix_analyst_restricted.
operation_legend.ferpa_education_records: Resources marked ferpa_education_record=true require disclosure basis assertion. The helix_analyst_standard role can access these only as aggregates with suppression. The helix_research role can access them only as de-identified extracts.
operation_legend.steward_scoping: The helix_steward column in the matrix shows the MAXIMUM access. Actual access is scoped to the steward's assigned domain (see ACM-SPECIAL-004).

references: govern/lakehouse-rbac-model.json — role definitions, masking policies, RLS patterns, platform implementations
govern/agent-guardrails.json — AI agent and NLQ access controls
govern/domain-taxonomy.json — domain assignments for steward scoping
coverage_check: Run tools/check_governance_coverage.py after adding or renaming any Core resource. It fails if a resource is missing from this matrix or a column exception names a column that isn't in the schema.
